grain: one source-listed point location per row
scope: City of Toronto citywide; not clipped to an active simulation district

source_record_id.meaning: Source layer record identifier; not a business registration ID

service_type.meaning: Source category/program type; definitions differ by source

institution_name.meaning: School board/institution label when supplied; not a general company operator ID

geography_id.meaning: City of Toronto source scope; not a neighbourhood assignment

published_at.meaning: Null unless the source states a publication/update date

source_updated_at.meaning: Layer edit timestamp when the API reports one; distinct from retrieval time

tracked_but_not_available_from_these_sou.grocery_operator_count: No reliable grocery chain/operator field in the selected retail layers.
tracked_but_not_available_from_these_sou.store_stock_or_daily_capacity: Location data do not report available food, shelf stock, sales, or throughput.
tracked_but_not_available_from_these_sou.local_retail_price: Location data do not report item-level prices.
tracked_but_not_available_from_these_sou.food_bank_demand_or_capacity: Food-support location data do not report daily requests, clients served, unmet need, or stock.
tracked_but_not_available_from_these_sou.school_meal_reach: Education locations do not report enrollment, program participation, or meals served.
